import os,json
os.makedirs('programs',exist_ok=True)
prog='''def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    def nb(r,c):
        return [(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=r+dr<h and 0<=c+dc<w]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r,c) in seen: continue
            col=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in nb(y,x):
                    if (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx]==col:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((col,cells))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for col,cells in comps:
        if len(cells)==1:
            r,c=cells[0]
            nc=Counter(g[y][x] for y,x in nb(r,c))
            m=max(nc.values()); cands=[k for k,v in nc.items() if v==m]
            best=cands[0] if len(cands)==1 else (g[r][c-1] if c>0 and g[r][c-1] in cands else cands[0])
            out[r][c]=best
    return out
'''

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    def nb(r,c):
        return [(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=r+dr<h and 0<=c+dc<w]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r,c) in seen: continue
            col=g[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in nb(y,x):
                    if (yy,xx) not in seen and g[yy][xx]==col:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((col,cells))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for col,cells in comps:

            m=max(nc.values()); cands=[k for k,v in nc.items() if v==m]
            best=min(cands,key=lambda k:cnt[k]) if len(cands)>1 else cands[0]
